title: Micro pulse playbook: manager prep for report sync
content:
Purpose: quick, high-signal 20–25 minute sync focused on immediate blockers, upcoming milestones, and one growth thread. Keep it pragmatic — leave with 2 concrete actions and a follow-up date.

Context / recent notes:
- Report: Mateo (IC) moved to Backend Core in Aug; currently pairing on latency regressions for batcher.
- Team: Serving-runtime sprint on latency optimizations (S-32). Mateo owns the KV-cache repro and test harness.
- Recent PRs: two small fixes merged; telemetry PR above is still in review and should land by Friday per Devika.

Quick metrics snapshot (from last dashboard pull, normalize before meeting):
- 95p latency (p50/p95 tokens) for zstd-quant model: 120ms / 410ms (target p95 < 350ms)
- Error budget consumed: 6% this sprint (goal < 5%)
- Mateo's task completion rate: 3/5 assigned stories closed this sprint

Agenda (20 minutes):
1) 3 min - Personal check-in: energy, time off, capacity constraints.
2) 7 min - Blockers & short signal: KV-cache repro status, tests flakiness, review backlog for telemetry PR.
3) 6 min - Priorities alignment: what to finish this week vs bump; define 'done' for KV-cache scope.
4) 4 min - Growth thread: pick one skill to advance (designing failure-tolerant batching) + one micro-experiment for the sprint.

Prep questions for Mateo (I will ask):
- How reproducible is the KV-cache failure now? Steps to reproduce in under 5 bullets?
- Which tests are flaky vs legitimately failing? If flaky, can we quarantine and add deterministic guard rails?
- Do you have a clear cut for MVP of the fix (unit tests + minimal integration) vs polish?
- Is review bandwidth the gating factor for telemetry PR? If yes, who can we tag to unblock?
- What specifically would you like coaching on for failure-tolerant batching?

Red flags to watch for during the conversation:
- Mateo says "I keep bouncing between tasks" — possibly overloaded; consider reassigning noncritical work.
- PRs blocked on review for >72 hours with no owner assigned.
- Acceptance criteria are fuzzy for KV-cache; risk of scope creep.

Desired outcomes by end of sync:
- Concrete reproduction steps for the KV-cache failure documented in the ticket.
- Action owner and ETA for the telemetry PR unblock.
- Agreement on a trimmed MVP for KV-cache fix (no more than 2 story points extra).
- One growth experiment agreed with a measurable signal and a 2-week timer.

Action items (capture during meeting) - template I will use: [action] -- owner -- due
- e.g. Document repro steps in JIRA-2389 -- Mateo -- 2027-11-13
- e.g. Tag telemetry reviewers on PR #452; request quick pass -- Devika -- 2027-11-12
- e.g. Add quarantine for flaky test suite to prevent CI noise -- Mateo + SRE -- 2027-11-15

Coaching notes (short drills I might use if conversation stalls):
- Ask: "If you could remove one thing from your plate this week, what would it be?" (reveals hidden friction)
- Frame trade-offs: "Finish MVP now and iterate vs polish and risk regression window" — help quantify user value and risk.
- Role-play quick design: whiteboard the failure case in 3 boxes (client -> batcher -> cache) to force scope clarity.

Follow-up / cadence:
- I will send a 1-paragraph recap in Slack after the sync with the three agreed actions and due dates.
- Put a 10-minute follow-up slot on calendar on 2027-11-16 to check progress on the KV-cache MVP.

Notes-to-self (private):
- Keep the tone empathetic; progress this sprint is more important than heroics.
- Avoid reassigning large tasks in the sync; prefer to negotiate scope reduction instead.
- Watch for recurring PR review bottleneck pattern; raise at triage if systemic.

Draft Slack recap (short):
"Thanks for the sync — quick recap: 1) Mateo will document KV-cache repro in JIRA-2389 by 11/13, 2) Devika will nudge telemetry PR reviewers (PR #452) by EOD 11/12, 3) Quarantine flaky tests and add guard rails by 11/15. Follow-up 10m on 11/16. Lmk if I missed anything."

Potential follow-up tickets to open after meeting (if needed):
- infra:quarantine-flaky-tests-2027-11 (owner: SRE)
- eng:kv-cache-mvp-scope (owner: Mateo)
- eng:review-rush-telemetry-452 (owner: Devika)

End of doc.
